STABL analysis with an explicit evidence mode

Source: R/analysis_workflow.R
stabl_analyze.Rd

Runs STABL feature selection in one of two explicitly declared modes: "exploratory" (full-data selection with descriptive, apparent interpretation) or "validated" (binary classification or gaussian regression with the whole pipeline — preprocessing, selection, tuning and prediction — isolated inside nested cross-validation training partitions).

Usage

stabl_analyze(
  x,
  y,
  family = c("binomial", "gaussian"),
  mode,
  preprocessing = NULL,
  resampling = c("nested_cv"),
  event_class = NULL,
  outer_v = 5L,
  outer_repeats = 1L,
  inner_v = 5L,
  stratified = TRUE,
  study_labels = NULL,
  lambda_grid = "auto",
  n_bootstraps = 100L,
  artificial_type = "random_permutation",
  hard_threshold = NULL,
  metric = NULL,
  cor_method = c("pearson", "spearman"),
  cor_threshold = 0.7,
  n_repeats = 20L,
  loss = NULL,
  random_state = NULL,
  final_refit = FALSE,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'stabl_analysis'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'stabl_analysis'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

x

Numeric feature matrix (samples × features) with row names (sample IDs) and column names (feature names).

y

Outcome aligned to the rows of x. Named vector or factor whose names cover exactly the row names of x. For family = "binomial", exactly two classes; for family = "gaussian", numeric.

family

"binomial" or "gaussian"; both are supported in exploratory and validated modes.

mode

Required. "exploratory" or "validated". There is no default: the evidence mode must be chosen explicitly.

preprocessing

Optional fold-safe preprocessing specification: NULL (identity), a character vector of transforms for stabl_preprocess_fit() ("zv", "impute_median", "center", "scale"), or an unprepped recipes::recipe(). In validated mode the transform is fitted anew on every inner- and outer-training split; in exploratory mode it is fitted once on the full data (an apparent, fitting-data transform). Fitted stabl_preprocessing objects are rejected.

resampling

Resampling scheme for validated mode; currently only "nested_cv" (via stabl_multiomic_nested_cv()). Ignored in exploratory mode.

event_class

For binary outcomes, the level treated as the event for probabilities, odds ratios and probability metrics; defaults to the second level of the outcome factor.

outer_v, outer_repeats, inner_v, stratified, study_labels, lambda_grid, n_bootstraps, artificial_type, hard_threshold

Validated-mode resampling and selection settings, passed to stabl_multiomic_nested_cv().

metric

Validated-mode candidate-selection metric, passed to stabl_multiomic_nested_cv(). NULL (default) resolves per family: "ber" for binomial, "rmse" for gaussian. Allowed values are "ber"/"accuracy" (binomial) and "rmse"/"mae"/"r2" (gaussian).

cor_method, cor_threshold

Correlation method and |correlation| threshold for redundancy groups. In validated mode, groups are derived on each fold's transformed training data only.

n_repeats

Number of permutation repeats for importance (per fold in validated mode).

loss

Loss for permutation importance: "squared_error" (gaussian), "brier" or "log_loss" (binomial). Positive importance means permuted_loss - baseline_loss > 0; negative values are retained.

random_state

Seed. Fold assignment, selection, and per-fold importance seeds are all derived from it deterministically.

final_refit

Logical; validated mode only. When TRUE, an explicitly labelled full-development refit (selection + interpretation on all data) is added for future inference. It is a different model from the cross-validation models and is not part of performance estimation.

...

Additional arguments passed to stabl_fit() (and, in validated mode, to stabl_multiomic_nested_cv()).

object

A "stabl_analysis" object (for summary).

Value

An object of class "stabl_analysis" with a mode field. Exploratory mode returns the full-data fit (a "stabl_fit"), its interpretation (a "stabl_interpretation", evidence type "post_selection_descriptive"), the fitted preprocessing transform, and provenance. Validated mode returns the underlying "stabl_multiomic_nested_cv" object in nested; fold-level held-out predictions (one row per sample per repeat; for binomial with event_probability for the named event_class, for gaussian with the numeric predicted response); performance (pooled and per-repeat; accuracy, BER, macro-F1, MCC, Brier score, clipped log loss and AUROC for binomial, or MAE, RMSE and R-squared for gaussian); fold-level selected_features; heldout_importance (per-feature and per-group permutation importance computed with each fold's own predictor on that fold's held-out rows, with correlation groups derived from training data only); and optionally final_refit. Validated evidence is labelled "cross_validated" with evaluation scope "held_out_assessment".

Functions

  • print(stabl_analysis): Print a concise summary of a "stabl_analysis" object; invisibly returns x.

  • summary(stabl_analysis): Return the key evidence table invisibly: the interpretation evidence for exploratory mode, or the held-out performance and importance summary for validated mode.

Examples

set.seed(2L)
ids <- paste0("s", 1:80)
x <- matrix(rnorm(80 * 8), 80, 8,
            dimnames = list(ids, paste0("f", 1:8)))
y <- setNames(factor(rep(c("A", "B"), each = 40L)), ids)
x[, 1] <- x[, 1] + 1.5 * as.numeric(y == "B")
x[, 2] <- x[, 2] - 1.2 * as.numeric(y == "B")

exploratory <- suppressWarnings(stabl_analyze(
  x, y, family = "binomial", mode = "exploratory",
  lambda_grid = data.frame(lambda = c(0.3, 0.2, 0.1)),
  n_bootstraps = 10L, random_state = 2L, n_repeats = 3L
))
summary(exploratory)
#> <stabl_analysis: exploratory >
#>   family:      binomial
#>   event class: B
#>   preprocessing: identity
#>   selected:     3 of 8 features
#>   evidence:    post_selection_descriptive (fitting_data; apparent)
#> 
#> Selected features (post-selection descriptive):
#>   feature stability coefficient effect_direction correlation_group
#> 1      f1       1.0   1.0698420         positive                 1
#> 2      f2       1.0  -0.8424217         negative                 2
#> 7      f7       0.7   0.5137596         positive                 3
#>   permutation_importance
#> 1             0.10213965
#> 2             0.05213274
#> 7             0.01112795

validated <- suppressWarnings(stabl_analyze(
  x, y, family = "binomial", mode = "validated",
  preprocessing = c("center", "scale"),
  lambda_grid = data.frame(lambda = c(0.3, 0.2, 0.1)),
  outer_v = 3L, inner_v = 3L, n_bootstraps = 10L,
  random_state = 2L, n_repeats = 3L
))
validated$performance$pooled
#>    n n_events accuracy balanced_error_rate macro_f1 mcc     brier  log_loss
#> 1 80       40      0.7                 0.3      0.7 0.4 0.1854775 0.5462153
#>     auroc
#> 1 0.81375
